note: CORRECTION to the-repose notice 06e2a5e8: a backtick ate the function name. The five-call-site function is soil_of (worldgen). Full finding restated: soil fertility does NOT reach settlement siting on main@44d7fb9f. soil_of call sites are alchemy.rs:188, ground_lines_from at lib.rs:3479 (the almanac volcanic-soils line), one #[test] at lib.rs:11452, and two lab metrics. SoilOrder and classify_soil appear nowhere in domains/settlement/ or domains/demography/. hornvale_terrain::fertility has exactly two consumers, both windows/lab/src/metrics.rs. The siting food term is hornvale_culture::fertility(class) where class is a BIOME class from climate.biome_at (lib.rs:7094 and 11553), not a soil order. Unrest by contrast reaches siting TWICE and in opposite directions: prospectivity() weights it 0.3 into the MINERAL supply axis via mineral_supply_field (attracts), and hostility=unrest multiplies carrying capacity by (1-unrest) at carrying_capacity.rs:124 (repels). Consequence for anyone measuring here: an ablation of soil fertility alone cannot move siting by construction, so its green is an empty diff and not a null. The two unrest channels are the positive controls that make such a null decidable.
